title: Joined
note: One accept, after the tap. The book's cover appears for the first time, with the child's name, and opens to the flyleaf: the name is seen here first (BL-322). The book comes with the next sync, under a thin bar with no count; the open book does not change by itself (only "Open the book" opens it). Here sync is held, so it says the book is on its way.
text: Asha From Mama You're in Asha's book Your letters and Mama's sit side by side, each signed. Asha's book is on its way to this phone. Close
